title: ZBrush likeness methods translated to Blender

queue.claim: Blender's 3D viewport Focal Length (default 50 mm) uses a doubled effective sensor (perspective zoom factor 2, about 72 mm), so viewport 50 mm is about 25 mm full-frame and about 71° horizontal field of view; the note advises setting 150–200 mm for a telephoto-like sculpting view.
queue.query: Blender viewport focal length 50mm not same as camera 50mm sensor 72mm CAMERA_PARAM_ZOOM_INIT_PERSP

queue.claim: Blender camera export conventions: lens = f_px * 36 / W with Sensor Fit Horizontal; shift_x = (W/2 - cx)/max(W,H); shift_y = (cy - H/2)/max(W,H) for pixel y pointing down; OpenCV-to-Blender camera conversion flips the y and z axes.
queue.query: Blender camera shift_x shift_y principal point cx cy OpenCV intrinsics conversion max(width height) sensor fit

queue.claim: Adult interpupillary distance has a mean of about 63 mm with SD of about 3.5–4 mm (Dodgson 2004); prescription 'near PD' is about 3 mm less than distance PD.
queue.query: Dodgson 2004 variation and extrema of human interpupillary distance mean standard deviation adults

queue.claim: ZBrush 4R8 (2017) introduced a Universal Camera with a real focal length in mm and storable or exportable cameras; ZBrush opens with perspective off; Spotlight is toggled with Shift+Z and its dial with Z.
